sourceText.he: אֵין שׁוֹחֲטִין לַגּוּמָּא וְכוּ׳. וְהָא אָמְרַתְּ: אֵין שׁוֹחֲטִין לַגּוּמָּא כְּלָל? אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: רֵישָׁא בְּגוּמָּא שֶׁבַּשּׁוּק.

positions.claim: the first clause speaks of a hole in the marketplace, where it is wholly forbidden
positions.basis: reading the two clauses as addressing different locations
